{{Quote|Assaulting my cruiser alone. Very careless of you, Orgus Din.|Darth Angral|<ref name="Nefarid" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] '''infiltrated''' the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], on the edges of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]]. Din intended to eliminate the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who was [[Desolator crisis|waging war]] on the Republic as a result of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis's]], [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Hero of Tython|Din's former apprentice]], but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] security forces and brought before Angral. The Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] killed the Jedi, broadcasting the execution live on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], and then jettisoned Din's body into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] before departing the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. However, Din planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on the ''Oppressor'' before his death, allowing the Republic to track the vessel to the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I haven't been searching for the apprentice. I've been hunting Darth Angral&mdash;and I just found his cruiser.|Orgus Din|<ref name="Nefarid" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] with a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, Tarnis's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Darth Angral]], witnessed his son's death, and the elder [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Desolator crisis|declared war]] upon the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in revenge, using information on the [[Republic superweapon initiative]] given to him by his son&mdash;who had been undercover as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] before his death&mdash;to seize control of the Republic's [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] projects.<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> One of these projects was the [[Death Mark laser]], which was being developed on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and Angral's apprentice [[Nefarid]] captured the weapon despite [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]'s attempts to defend it.<ref name="Spy Hunter" />

Din was the former teacher of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had killed Tarnis, and, after the former student rescued the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master from the ruins of the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory]]&mdash;the research facility that housed the Death Mark laser project&mdash;the two Jedi learned that Nefarid was randomly targeting [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] with the Death Mark laser.<ref name="Siege">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Siege Hunter|Alderaan}}</ref> The Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Aleyna Hark]] had been seen near the [[Thul Palace|mountain compound]] of the Alderaanian [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Horis Thul]], and, while the Knight rushed to the compound to prevent Thul's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], Din claimed that he would track down Nefarid and the Death Mark laser.<ref name="Spy Hunter" /> However, Din lied&mdash;following the call of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he located Angral's [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], on the edges of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="Nefarid" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Pity you didn't bring your student. I could kill you both. Tell me, Jedi. Are you afraid to die?''"<br />"''There is no death. There is only the Force.''"<br />"''If there is no death&hellip; where is my son?|Darth Angral and Orgus Din|<ref name="Nefarid" />}}
[[File:Oppressor.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Oppressor'']]
Deciding to put a stop to the crisis involving Angral, Din prepared to board the ''Oppressor'' and confront the Sith. When contacted by his former apprentice, Din confessed the truth, and he wished the Knight luck on confronting Nefarid in the [[Lord Nefarid's hideout|Sith's stronghold]]. Din infiltrated the ''Oppressor'' before it left the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], but he was only able to plant a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] before he was detected by the vessel's security forces. Wounded, the Jedi Master was brought before Angral on the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] broadcast a transmission of the events on the bridge across the entire [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. Din's former apprentice had just [[Battle in Nefarid's hideout|attacked Nefarid's base]] on Alderaan, and the Sith decided to display the feed from the ''Oppressor'' in order to torment his opponent. Upon being presented with Din, with whom Angral had maintained a rivalry since the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Empire almost a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] earlier, the Sith Lord mocked his opponent's attempt and questioned whether Din was ready to die. Angral then [[Shiak|stabbed]] the Jedi through the abdomen, killing his opponent.<ref name="Nefarid" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Darth Angral broadcasted Orgus's execution over the HoloNet. Left the body floating in space for us to find. A Republic shuttle just recovered the remains from the edge of the Alderaan system. I'm sorry.|General [[Var Suthra]]|<ref name="Nefarid" />}}
Before departing the Alderaan system, Angral ordered Din's body to be shot into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], though a Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] later recovered the Jedi Master's corpse and returned it to the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] for a proper burial. Despite witnessing Din's death, the Knight defeated Nefarid in battle and destroyed the Death Mark laser.<ref name="Nefarid" /> Angral then traveled to the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]], where he used his recently-constructed [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] superweapon to [[Devastation of Uphrades|attack]] the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Uphrades]]&mdash;an action that killed millions of civilians. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] used Din's tracking beacon to locate the ''Oppressor'',<ref name="Uphrades" /> though Din's former student was unable to catch up to Angral until the Sith attacked Tython itself and forced a [[Battle of the Oppressor|confrontation]] with the young Jedi.<ref name="Fate">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Orgus Din's mission to the ''Oppressor'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. During the Jedi Knight class mission "Facing Lord Nefarid," players witness Din's death before fighting Nefarid in his hideout.<ref name="Nefarid" />
